seo.title: Dollar General: AI-generated in-store audio retail media network - 12,000 stores (2026)
seo.meta_description: DG Media Network extends its AI-generated in-store audio network with QSIC to roughly 6,000 more stores, bringing the total to 12,000 stores in Q2 2026.
seo.resume_citable: In April 2026, DG Media Network extended its network of AI-generated in-store audio ads with the QSIC platform to roughly 6,000 additional stores across 48 states, doubling its audio presence to reach 12,000 equipped stores in the second quarter of 2026.

faq.q: How many Dollar General stores broadcast AI-generated audio ads?
faq.a: The extension with QSIC adds roughly 6,000 stores across 48 states, which doubles the existing audio presence and brings the total to 12,000 equipped stores in the second quarter of 2026.

faq.q: How does DG Media Network's in-store audio network work?
faq.a: The QSIC platform combines point-of-sale data, curated music, and AI-generated audio ads to broadcast localized, real-time messages in stores, with delivery verification and closed-loop reporting.

pattern: In-store audio retail media network, with AI-generated and localized audio ads
objectif_business: Turn the physical store network into addressable, sellable ad inventory and draw a high-margin retail media revenue stream from it. AI-generated audio lets advertisers get localized, real-time messaging, measurable store by store, with particular reach in the rural areas that Dollar General covers densely.
description: DG Media Network, Dollar General's retail media arm, is extending its in-store audio network on the QSIC platform. QSIC combines point-of-sale data, curated music, and AI-generated audio ads to broadcast targeted, localized messages in stores. The April 2026 announcement covers a rollout to roughly 6,000 additional stores across 48 states, which doubles the existing audio presence and brings the total to 12,000 equipped stores in the second quarter of 2026. The platform exceeds IAB standards with delivery verification and closed-loop reporting that gives brands a read on the incremental impact of their spend. QSIC claims more than 350 million shoppers reached each month globally. Dollar General operates more than 20,000 stores in the US, with roughly 75% of the US population within five miles (about 8 km) of a location, which gives the network strong reach in rural and often underserved communities.
points_cles: In-store retail media audio network with AI-generated and localized audio ads.
The QSIC platform wired to POS data, DG Media Network as the retail media arm.
Extension to roughly 6,000 stores, total brought to 12,000 stores in Q2 2026.

resultats.metrique: Equipped stores added across 48 states by the QSIC extension
Total stores with in-store audio in Q2 2026, doubling the existing presence
Shoppers reached each month by the QSIC network worldwide
US footprint, roughly 75% of the population within five miles of a store
Verified delivery and reporting, beyond IAB standards

niveau_preuve.justification: Figures published in the joint official press release from DG Media Network / QSIC (a T1 primary source from the subject brand and its platform partner): 6,000 stores added, 12,000 total in Q2 2026, more than 350 million monthly shoppers. Corroborated by established trade press (Retail Dive). These are deployment and reach figures announced jointly by the brand and the vendor, not financial results or an audited incremental: the case therefore does not rise to level A despite the strength of the sources.

stack_technique.detail: Retail audio platform that integrates point-of-sale (POS) data, curated music, and AI-generated audio ads to plan, create, broadcast, measure, and optimize in-store audio messaging. Delivery verification and closed-loop reporting, beyond IAB standards.
Dollar General's retail media arm. It sells the retailer's ad inventory to brands; the in-store audio network is one of its formats, here extended through QSIC.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Continuous in-store broadcast; campaigns planned and optimized on an ongoing basis, with context refreshed by POS data
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: DG Media Network, Dollar General's retail media arm, on the QSIC platform
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: Per-store point-of-sale data (products, promotions, peak times) and the store's geography. That context is what makes the message localized and real-time; without this feed, broadcasting falls back to generic and loses its value for the advertiser.

etapes.detail: An advertiser books in-store audio inventory with DG Media Network, with geographic targeting and delivery commitments.
QSIC ingests POS data and the local context of each store to frame the message to broadcast.
The platform generates or assembles the localized audio spots and schedules them by store and by slot, interleaved with the curated music.
The spots play on the speakers of equipped stores, at the scheduled time.
QSIC verifies delivery and returns closed-loop reporting to the advertiser on reach and incremental impact.

prerequis_data: Per-store point-of-sale data, available in near real time
A geographic reference and local attributes per store
A product catalog and promotional calendar
Structured audio inventory (equipped stores, available slots)
prerequis_orga: A dedicated retail media arm (ad sales, ad ops, advertiser relations)
A network of physical stores equipped with audio hardware
A measurement and reporting framework accepted by advertisers
Compliance with transparency obligations on AI-generated audio content
stack_possible: A retail audio platform like QSIC (generation, scheduling, broadcast, measurement)
Integration of POS feeds into the platform
An AI engine to generate audio spots
Closed-loop reporting tooling toward the advertiser
replication.premiere_etape: Map the available audio inventory (equipped stores, slots, geographic coverage) and connect per-store POS data before offering the first format to advertisers.

playbook.action: Audit the store network: audio hardware in place, coverage, high-traffic areas.
Integrate per-store POS data to contextualize the messaging (products, promotions, moments).
playbook.livrable: POS feed connected to the audio platform.

playbook.action: Set up AI audio generation and scheduling by store and by slot via a platform like QSIC.
playbook.livrable: Pipeline to create and broadcast localized spots.

playbook.action: Structure the retail media arm's commercial offer: formats, pricing, geographic targeting, delivery commitments.
Wire measurement: delivery verification and closed-loop reporting toward the advertiser.

replication.equipe: A retail media arm (sales and ad ops), a data team for the POS feeds and local context, store operations for the audio hardware, and a platform partner for generation and broadcast.

statut_vivant.note: The in-store audio network already exists (the QSIC extension doubles an already operational presence of roughly 6,000 stores). The goal of 12,000 stores was set for the second quarter of 2026; a recent announcement (April 2026), with no signal of withdrawal. We have no post-completion source confirming that all 12,000 stores are in service.

transposable_ue.note: The principle (broadcasting AI-generated audio spots in stores, contextualized by point-of-sale data and geography) transfers to a European retailer that operates a physical footprint and a retail media arm. Targeting here relies on aggregated per-store context (what sells, when, where), not individual data, which limits GDPR exposure; if personal data entered the loop, a clear legal basis would be needed. Under the AI Act, an AI-generated audio ad falls under transparency obligations on synthetic content. The in-store audio hardware and advertiser deals still have to be built locally.
